newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 cotton crop 15.65 mln bales - trade.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 cotton crop 15.65 mln bales - trade.

text.p: India's cotton crop in 1996/97 (October/September) is expected to be around 15.65 million 170 kg bales, marginally lower than the previous season's 16 million bales, a trade organisation said on Tuesday.

The East India Cotton Association (EICA) said it had arrived at the current season's crop figure after taking into account the estimates of the official Cotton Advisory Board (CAB) and crop information gathered from its affiliates country-wide.
The CAB, which met in Bombay last week, estimated the 1996/97 crop at 15.50 million bales against the previous year's 16.15 million.
Traders said the CAB figure of 16.15 million was marginally higher than EICA's 16 million because the former was for 13 months from September last year to September this year.
The CAB has changed the September/August crop year to October/September from the 1996/97 season, thereby giving the previous season 13 months.
